headline: Playground fencing at Cunningham and Nathanael Greene schools, a Jenks hot water tank replacement, and a green roof proposal.
summary: Updates will cover tree trimming, Baldwin, the Fallon roof, and Varieur bathroom partitions. Items for discussion and action include fencing and a gate at Cunningham and pre-K fencing at Nathanael Greene.
items: Fallon Memorial Elementary School pre-K playground fence repairs
Varieur Elementary School bathroom partitions update
Cunningham Elementary School playground fencing and gate installation
Jenks Middle School domestic hot water tank replacement
Nathanael Greene Elementary School pre-K playground fencing installation
location: Superintendent Conference Room, Pawtucket School Department Administration Building, 286 Main St., Pawtucket, RI 02860
